fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: A high-quality, rapidly growing company with strong margins and significant free cash flow, trading at a reasonable forward multiple.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimate by 1.4%; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 16.2% YoY, with analyst estimates for current FY at 42.3%.
Exceptional earnings growth of 86.4% YoY and 82.8% for the last quarter.
Substantial free cash flow of $25.99B TTM.
negatives: Last quarter missed EPS estimate by 1.4%.
Debt/Equity ratio of 53.79% is notable, though offset by strong cash flow.
Beta of 1.49 indicates higher volatility than the broader market.

news.paragraph: Netflix is facing mixed signals, with Jim Cramer expressing a desire to buy the stock while other reports highlight factors dragging it down. The company has seen a change in chairmanship with Jay Hoag taking over, amid a focus on advertising and live events. Despite some headwinds, analysts believe Netflix will maintain its global lead in streaming consolidation, with strong growth estimates for the current fiscal year.
